question: What kind of knowledge is affirmed in the Svacchanda teaching about attaining Shiva-hood?
premises: One may understand oneself as having attained Shiva-hood.
It is not mere procedural knowledge.
inference: The realization of Shiva-hood is presented as more than technical or ritual procedure.
plain_english: Thus, understanding oneself as having attained Shiva-hood, it was defined in the Svacchanda teaching that this is not knowledge limited to mere procedure.
